stories.title: LTM and ServiceNow expand enterprise agent delivery around an internal governance blueprint
stories.summary:
ServiceNow and LTM announced on November 5 a planned expansion of their partnership to combine the ServiceNow AI Platform with LTM’s engineering and transformation services for enterprise agent deployments.[3][22] The companies intend to use LTM’s internal rollout as a reference for joint solutions and sales programs serving more than 700 shared customers, rather than presenting this as a newly completed rollout across those customers.[3][22] ServiceNow reports that LTM has deployed 1,500 agents internally, with centralized AI inventory and risk oversight; these are company-reported deployment figures, not an independent audit.[3] The projected improvement of up to 80 percent in AI asset management and efficiency is an expectation, not an established result of the expanded partnership.[3][22] Neither source discloses engagement prices or contract values.[3][22] For an implementation agency, the useful pattern is to pair a narrowly scoped workflow deployment with an agent inventory, permission review and recurring governance support.

Sources:
[3] https://newsroom.servicenow.com/press-releases/details/2026/LTM-and-ServiceNow-expand-partnership-to-scale-agentic-AI-and-accelerate-joint-go-to-market
[22] https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/servicenow-and-ltm-deepen-ai-partnership-to-serve-700-shared-clients/article71669257.ece
